title: Parallax Thumbnail Spec
description: Per-episode thumbnail authoring file. Lists 1+ concept variants (A/B/C/...) for the Remotion `Thumbnail` composition. Consumed by `remotion-templates/scripts/generate-thumbnails.mjs`; outputs land in `episodes/<slug>/thumbnails/concept-<id>.png` for A/B selection before YouTube upload. Each concept's `data` block is a complete `ThumbnailData` object (see `src/templates/Thumbnail/types.ts`); the script does not synthesize fields, so anything the chosen layout needs must be present.

episode.description: Episode slug, must match the directory name under `episodes/`. Used to resolve the output directory.

notes.description: Optional free-form note (e.g. which concept Tiger prefers, what variant the next round should try). Ignored by the renderer.

concepts.description: Ordered list of thumbnail concepts to render. Each becomes one PNG.

id.description: Short concept identifier (typically a single lowercase letter: 'a', 'b', 'c'). Used as the output filename suffix — `concept-<id>.png`. Must be unique within the spec.

label.description: Human-readable description of the concept (e.g. 'Juxtaposition — fab vs map'). Shown in render logs; ignored by the composition itself.

data.description: Full `ThumbnailData` object passed as `props.data` to the Remotion Thumbnail composition. Required fields depend on `layout`: see `src/templates/Thumbnail/types.ts` for the field reference and which fields each layout consumes.

layout.description: Layout mode. Determines which fields are read: juxtaposition uses titleText/statPrimary/statContrast/imageSrc; data-provocation uses heroText/subText/imageSrc; symbolic uses illustrationSrc/symbolTitle.

episode.description: Episode identifier, typically matching the top-level `episode` slug.
